title: ACE FTP adapter connection drops after 5 minutes of inactivity
description: The monthly supplier file exchange flow uses FTP to collect files from 3 external suppliers. Since the FTP server was upgraded last month, connections that are idle for more than 5 minutes get dropped. This causes the flow to fail when it tries to list the directory after an idle period.

worklogs.description: Confirmed FTP server idle timeout is set to 300 seconds (5 minutes) in the new server configuration.
Reviewed ACE FTP configurable service settings. Connection pooling is enabled with no keepalive configured.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Hello, I found the cause. The new FTP server has a 5-minute idle timeout which is shorter than the time between file directory checks in your flow. The ACE FTP adapter maintains a pooled connection which gets dropped by the server after 5 minutes of no activity. I have two solutions: disable connection pooling for this adapter so each operation creates a fresh connection, or configure a keepalive that sends a NOOP command before the idle timeout.
